gaia-425040000962559616.x: Artificial megastructure (Topopolis) orbiting Eta Cassiopeiae housing the Quinlan civilisation in Heaven's River.
Nearby binary star system (~19.4 ly) featuring a solar-type G0V dwarf orbited by an orange K-type dwarf.

iapetus.x: Two-tone Saturnian moon whose bright equatorial oval houses the TMA-2 Star Gate monolith in the 1968 novel 2001: A Space Odyssey.
Saturnian moon where archaeological survey teams discover an artificial ice tower carved by an ancient extraterrestrial intelligence with an ominous warning glyph.

gaia-3796442680948579328.x: Intended colonial destination planet of the Bussard ramjet starship Leonora Christine orbiting Beta Virginis (Zavijava) before a deceleration malfunction forces a cosmic relativistic voyage.
gaia-3796442680948579328.a: Hal Clement, Robert L. Forward, Allen Steele, Poul Anderson

coalsack-nebula.x: Yellow G-type star silhouetted like a pinpoint pupil against the dark Coalsack Nebula (The Face of God), enclosing the biological hyper-specialized Motie civilization.

hip-113963.x: Blue-white subgiant star anchoring the southwestern corner of the Great Square of Pegasus.
hip-113963.a: International Astronomical Union (IAU) / Hipparcos / Gaia DR3
